reviews.comment: Ty's lectures are great. He gives lots of examples and shows videos. Class is required but he makes it interesting. The class has 3 exams, 1 individual assignment, and 1 group project/presentation. Participation is also one final grade. Study for the exams and you will do great. He's very chill and I would definitely take him again.

Took professor Ty for MKTG 438 and 322 and he was my favorite professor this semester! However, just know that these two classes have very different environments. 438 is very lecture heavy and he's a little more serious, the tests are a lot more knowledge based with a final project instead of exam. 322 was very lighthearted and a lot easier!
Good teacher with really interactive and funny lectures. As long as you go to class and take the power point notes you will get an A.

Professor Ty is a great professor. He puts energy, enthusiasm, and clarity into his lectures!. I found him pretty chill and laid back overall. The class consists of textbook quizzes, a simulation, and a group project. Not too hard as long as you put the work in. Overall, take professor Ty if you get the chance! He helped me learn quite a lot!

Professor Ty is a caring, enthusiastic, funny professor! He truly puts his best when it comes to lecturing, answering student questions, and his test reviews where he dresses up for them! Unlike many other classes I've taken, I actually learned a lot and will apply this knowledge to future career interests! I highly recommend taking professor Ty!

Professor Ty was great!! Hes enthusiastic about what hes teaching and teaches it well. Doesnt try to trick you or anything, just go to class, pay attention, & take good notes and youll be fine on tests. 10/10 recommend, honestly my favorite professor Ive had

He is a great lecturer and understands the content well. However, when it comes to grading he was extremely strict on two different occasions which ultimately shafted my grade by a whole letter grade. Do not take his group projects lightly and come extremely prepared for your presentation. He will ruin your grade if he finds any way to do so.
